scope_basis: scripts/audit_scope.py core + keeper classes; 119 Rust files; mock/test code excluded; governance and keeper rest are context only
concurrency_adaptation: Runtime permits three child agents at once; twelve specialties run in four waves per pass. No specialty omitted by this adaptation.
existing_issue_comparison: The source repository contains earlier AI audit reports and an issue register. NEW in rust-auditor means absent from this local ledger, not necessarily previously unknown to the project. Final comparison will identify known issues separately.
validation_mode: Static source review and arithmetic reasoning; no --poc flag, no builds or new runtime regression tests in this scan.
reading_coverage: Each specialist receives the complete frozen source bundle and records actual full, bounded, search-only, and unread areas. A specialist completing its review does not mean it read all 58,914 source lines. Consolidated coverage and remaining limits are recorded separately.

final_coverage.limits: Union coverage records actual production reading across specialists; it is not every file under every lens, runtime verification or a clean-security conclusion. Pass1economic-security tool error remains a coverage loss.

patch_policy: Draft patches are static proposals with per-option limits. In particular, clearing carry into dust does not pay former lenders/reclassify backing; hash bootstrap is required for existing hashless deployments; integration and tests remain implementation work.
artifact_policy: The pinned upstream assemble.sh is the sole full-report producer. Raw reports, every disposition, prior comparisons, patch applicability checks and honest read coverage are preserved. Source and tracked files remain unchanged.
final_checks: Every raw candidate has one disposition; run markers and assembled counts agree; all31ledger entries have scans=1; HEAD and119source hashes unchanged; no staged/tracked changes.
